background: eligible AOI cells more than 2 cells (60 m, Chebyshev) from any candidate cell

exclusions.not_tuned: 22L rule thresholds unchanged; no classifier trained

forbidden_metrics: no mining precision, recall, F1 or accuracy

hypotheses.H1: clusters overlap GFC loss in 2024 or 2025 (lossyear 24/25) more often than shape-preserving random placements
hypotheses.H2: clusters have higher mean hard-commodities probability than random placements
hypotheses.context: loss before 2024 (lossyear 1-23) and treecover2000 reported descriptively

interpretation: independent-product agreement; candidates remain UNKNOWN; not mining or loss confirmation
limitations: 1 km driver cells are larger than the 1.92 km AOI's internal structure: candidates and background share few cells, so H2 has very low power and is expected to be near null
drivers describe 2001-2024 dominant driver, not the 2023-25 seasonal change; hard commodities include energy infrastructure
GFC loss needs prior tree cover and Landsat-scale stand-replacement; small, partial or non-forest change is missed
GFC annual years do not match the Nov-Mar seasons; 2024 and 2025 are pooled
east-90-562 and west-85-563 share Sentinel-2 acquisitions; cells within AOIs are spatially dependent
null_outcomes: zero overlap, equal or lower agreement, masked driver cells and AOIs without driver data are reported as measured

products.catalog_verified: Earth Engine catalog pages read 2026-11-20; asset metadata re-checked by the first acquisition request

drivers.coverage: dominant driver of GFC v1.12 loss 2001-2024

hansen.citation: Hansen et al. 2013 Science 342:850; GFC v1.13

sampling: both products sampled on the frozen 30 m EPSG:32646 AOI grids by Earth Engine default nearest-neighbour reprojection (cell-centre rule); 1 km driver cells identified locally from the driver projection
uncertainty: shape-preserving translation permutation within each AOI's background, stratified by AOI, 10000 draws, seed 46; two-sided p around the null median; Wilson 95% CI for cluster fractions
